roster.name: Amazon
roster.note: public search.json, full-text over the posting body; endpoint reused from unifier-jobs where it was live-verified 2026-07-30. Amazon's NYC finance org (Ads, Prime Video, Devices) is the densest single source of in-range Finance Manager / Sr Finance Manager roles on this roster.

roster.name: Meta
roster.note: graphql CPJobSearchSourceQuery; doc_id + request shape reused from unifier-jobs (captured 2026-07-17, long-lived but can rotate — a rotation shows up as a fail_streak health warning, not silent zeroes).

roster.name: Google
roster.note: unifier-jobs monitored Google via a generic_page keyword check, which is useless here (every careers page contains the word "finance"). Probe round 1 (2026-08-10) ruled out both v3 search shapes: careers.google.com /api/v3/search returned 404 JSON and the www.google.com/about/careers /applications/api/v3/search path returned a 404 HTML page. Needs a fresh capture of what the live careers UI actually calls (browser XHR sniff, the technique that cracked Meta in unifier-jobs).

roster.name: NVIDIA
roster.note: cxs endpoint reused from unifier-jobs (verified 2026-07-30, inventory 2000). Workday searchText is fuzzy — expect unrelated hits that the function/seniority gates drop. That is noise, not breakage.

roster.name: Adobe
roster.note: cxs verified by probe round 1 on 2026-08-10 (200, inventory 801). The AdobeCareers site name is a 404 — external_experienced is the right one.

roster.name: Salesforce
roster.note: cxs verified by probe round 1 on 2026-08-10 (200, inventory 1467). Host matters — wd12 works, wd1 answers 422 for the same tenant/site.

roster.name: Intuit
roster.note: probe round 1 (2026-08-10) got 401 for both intuitcareers and IntuitExternalCareerSite on wd1 — authenticated tenant, not a wrong site name. Find the real host/site from a jobs link on intuit.com/careers before guessing again.

roster.name: PayPal
roster.note: cxs verified by probe round 1 on 2026-08-10 (200, inventory 110). That inventory is small for PayPal — if the board looks thin, check whether this site holds only part of their req population.

roster.name: Airbnb
roster.note: verified by probe round 1 on 2026-08-10 (200, 181 jobs on the board). Greenhouse returns the whole board and we filter client-side, so one request covers every query — see queries_for() in main.py.

roster.name: Pinterest
roster.note: verified by probe round 1 on 2026-08-10 (200, 218 jobs).

roster.name: Stripe
roster.note: verified by probe round 1 on 2026-08-10 (200, 557 jobs).

roster.name: Datadog
roster.note: verified by probe round 1 on 2026-08-10 (200, 445 jobs). NYC-headquartered, so a high share of its finance org is in scope.

roster.name: DoorDash
roster.note: probe round 1 (2026-08-10) got 404 for the "doordash" board token — they have moved off the public Greenhouse board API. Find the current ATS from a job link on careersatdoordash.com before re-enabling.

roster.name: Apple
roster.note: needs a custom adapter — jobs.apple.com posts to its own search-reference API (csrf token required). Not a Workday/Greenhouse shape.

roster.name: Microsoft
roster.note: needs a custom adapter — gcsservices.careers.microsoft.com JSON API.

roster.name: Netflix
roster.note: needs a custom adapter — Eightfold ATS (explore.jobs.netflix.net /api/apply/v2/jobs). Eightfold is also used by several other targets, so this adapter would pay for itself.

roster.name: Uber
roster.note: needs a custom adapter — uber.com/api/loadSearchJobsResults (POST).

roster.name: Spotify
roster.note: needs a custom adapter — lifeatspotify.com/api/jobs. Probe round 1 also ruled out a "spotify" Greenhouse board (404).

roster.name: LinkedIn
roster.note: careers.linkedin.com only. NOT to be scraped via linkedin.com job search — see CLAUDE.md rule 3 (account-ban risk). Leave disabled unless a non-LinkedIn-domain endpoint is found.

roster.name: Block
roster.note: verified by probe round 1 on 2026-08-10 (200, 190 jobs) — the "block" Greenhouse board token is live, so no custom adapter needed.

roster.name: Oracle
roster.note: endpoint reused from unifier-jobs (needs expand=all, limit 100). Its keyword match is fuzzy across the whole site, so a single narrower search_query beats the default query set here.

roster.name: Accenture
roster.note: reused from unifier-jobs. Their cxs endpoint is intermittently flaky (returns HTML instead of JSON some hours) — treat fail_streaks of 3 or fewer as flakiness, not breakage. Categorised advertising because Accenture Song is the owner's adjacent-industry route, but its corporate finance org is the actual target here.

roster.name: Publicis Groupe
roster.note: probe round 1 (2026-08-10): the postings API answers 200 with totalFound=0 for PublicisGroupe, Publicis, Havas and dentsu alike, so a 200 here does not mean the token is right — an unknown company returns an empty result, not a 404. Read the real token off a live SmartRecruiters apply URL before enabling. The adapter itself is proven (built for Turner & Townsend in unifier-jobs).

roster.name: WPP
roster.note: holdco careers page is a brochure. WPP hires through its operating companies (GroupM, Ogilvy, VML, Hogarth, Burson), each with its own ATS — so this is 5+ endpoints, not one. Deferred; expand only if the board is thin.

roster.name: Omnicom
roster.note: same fragmentation as WPP (BBDO, DDB, OMD, Annalect each separate).

roster.name: Dentsu
roster.note: ATS unidentified — sweep for ATS markers first.

roster.name: Havas
roster.note: ATS unidentified — sweep for ATS markers first.
